description: Évolution du trait de côte et bilan érosion-sédimentation sur la côte sableuse d’Hauteville-sur-mer en 2008 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Evolution of the coastline estimated from comparison of old and recent photographs, 6 profiles (pointe d'Agon, beach of Monmartin-sur-mer, Garennes, dike of Hauteville-sur-mer, southern beach of Hauteville-sur-mer and Annoville) and a numerical model of terrain. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Evolution of the coastline and erosion-sedimentation balance on the sandy coast of Hauteville-sur-mer in 2008" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include manche, dynamiques sédimentaires. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
